statement: Nvidia is in early talks with South Korean inference-chip designer Rebellions about a partnership, investment or possible acquisition.
why: The leading merchant GPU vendor engaging a well-funded NPU designer signals that data-center inference silicon is becoming a contested supply lane.

impact.mechanism: An independently funded inference-NPU designer backed by SK Hynix, Samsung Ventures and Arm represents alternative accelerator supply that Nvidia is now seeking to partner with or absorb.

evidence.excerpt: possible collaborations, including a technical partnership, an investment or perhaps even an acquisition.

confidence.basis: Single secondary wire story; neither company commented and talks are described as preliminary.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: Yahoo Finance (Bloomberg wire story)
